notes.title: Greetings, Commander! Set course for update!
notes.content:
* New ALTERNATIVE COMBAT CONTROLS - get a new gaming experience in dynamic battles!

* Bug fixes at the request of players, including problems with torpedoes on the USS Missouri, shooting through the USS Oscar Austin, memorizing the type of projectiles, and much more.



Soon after the update

* Halloween decoration of the game.

* New Battle Pass season.

* New rewards for game progress.



May the Force of Warships be with you!

notes.title: Greetings, Commander! Set course for update!
notes.content:
Important technical improvements.

Bug fixes at the request of players, including an endless search for combat in case of connection problems, a bug with ships sailing to an island on the New Atlantis map, an air defense bug on the Mikhail Kutuzov, strike group indicatos, and much more.

Tier 10 ships are now available in the game! Get ready for massive battles ahead!

The new Battle Pass “Raid for Containers” has started! Unique rewards are already waiting for you!

May the Force of Warships be with you!

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
What's new in this version:

 Important UI fixes.
 Many improvements and fixes to the start and end of the battle.
 Bug fixes at the request of players, including UI issues, ship detection, localization, background music support and other edits.
 The new Battle Pass season.
 Festive decoration in the game.


Soon after the update

 New Supply opportunities.


A hotfix will be released soon to address the following issues:

 Respawning players inside bots
 Displaying battle rewards with a premium account


May the Force of Warships be with you!

notes.title: Update 6.01.4
notes.content:
What's new in this version:
* Fix of the air defense on the RU Nikolayev ship.
* Fix minor bugs in the Battle Pass UI and effects of unique ship.
* Minor bugfixes and little improvements.

May the Force of Warships be with you!

notes.title: Greetings, Commander! Set course for update!

notes.title: Update 5.14
notes.content:
* Guide button in the side menu of main screen - now it's always at hand!
* Colorful and useful interface improvements
* Fixed: start of battle among the enemy team, errors in the combat interface, bug in the scoring of Battle Tasks and much more
Also will be available soon after update:
* New combat unit - helicopters! And, of course, air defense consumable
* New Fleet emblems that won the Competition
Follow the news! There are a lot of new things ahead!

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
* Improved interface and informativeness of premium ships.
* Reduced deceleration of ships near objects and islands on battle maps.
* Fixed a bug with zero progress in capturing the base with the participation of allies in the capture.
* Many minor modifications and improvements.
Follow our news! There are a lot of new things ahead!
